steps.say: **Export CSV** takes the class list off the screen and into a spreadsheet, for a report or a register you keep elsewhere.
What you export is what you can see, so filter the table down first if you only want part of it.
The file downloads to your own device with today's date in its name.
steps.terminal: That's exporting your class list — what is on screen, in a file. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
